additional_info.subject: RE: ID0484906-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/RD170003080] Firmware Integration CRM:03288000557
additional_info.body:
Good morning Mr. Rafiq,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support team in regards of ticket
ID0484906
. The ticket was opened from your side to request information whether our Sicharge D have the DigiCert Global Root G2 certcificate installed to maintain connectivity with Backend providers after 1st April 2026.
I got information from our Firmware team that the
DigiCert Global Root G2 certificate
is already included in the
Sicharge D FW v8.1.4
, and of course will be included in any future FW release.
I had a quick overview on our SCB, and saw that all the #3 chargers from VW Group France are already running on FW v8.1.4.
In case you will commission and activate new chargers, please ensure to update them to v8.1.4 at the soonest.
If there are no further questions or doubts, I will proceed to close this ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
Important notice: This e-mail and any attachment thereof contain corporate proprietary information. If you have received it by mistake, please notify us immediately by reply e-mail and delete this e-mail and its attachments from your system.
Thank you.
